column3: With respect to the International Plaza Mortgage Loan (7.0%), the borrower has a leasehold interest in the mortgaged property pursuant to two ground leases: (i) a ground lease from Hillsborough County Aviation Authority for Parcel 1, comprising the majority of the mortgaged property, and (ii) a ground lease from IP Land Associates LLC for Parcel E, comprising the spaces currently occupied by Crate & Barrel and Ocean Prime. Both ground leases expire on December 31, 2080, with no extension options. The ground lessor has a right of first refusal (ROFR) if the ground lessee sells or assigns its interest in the leased premised. The ROFR is not extinguished by foreclosure; however, the ROFR does not apply to any assignment to or by any leasehold mortgagee or its nominee, or pursuant to a foreclosure or deed in lieu thereof.
